title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
description: 50 questions about the TV comedy Brooklyn Nine-Nine, from season 1 to season 8. Each game asks you 10.

questions.text: Who created Brooklyn Nine-Nine?
questions.explanation: Dan Goor and Michael Schur created the show.

questions.text: On which TV network did Brooklyn Nine-Nine start?
questions.explanation: Fox showed the first five seasons.

questions.text: Which network took the show for season 6?
questions.explanation: NBC also showed the final season, in 2021.

questions.text: How many seasons does Brooklyn Nine-Nine have?
questions.explanation: The final season was season 8.

questions.text: Which police precinct do the detectives work in?
questions.explanation: It is a fictional precinct in Brooklyn, New York.

questions.text: In 2014, the show won a Golden Globe. For what?
questions.explanation: It won in its first year on the air.

questions.text: About how many episodes does the whole series have?
questions.explanation: The show ran for eight seasons.

questions.text: The show started in 2013. In which year did it end?
questions.explanation: The last episode, 'The Last Day', was shown in September 2021.

questions.text: Which actor plays Jake Peralta?
questions.explanation: Andy Samberg won a Golden Globe for playing Jake.

questions.text: Which actress plays Rosa Diaz?
questions.explanation: Stephanie Beatriz is in the main cast.

questions.text: Which actor plays Terry Jeffords?
questions.explanation: Terry Crews is in the main cast.

questions.text: Which actress plays Amy Santiago?
questions.explanation: Melissa Fumero is in the main cast.

questions.text: Which actor plays Charles Boyle?
questions.explanation: Joe Lo Truglio is in the main cast.

questions.text: Which actress plays Gina Linetti?
questions.explanation: Chelsea Peretti is a main cast member in the first seasons.

questions.text: Which actor plays Captain Raymond Holt?
questions.explanation: Holt arrives as the new captain at the start of the series.

questions.text: Which actor plays Hitchcock?
questions.explanation: Hitchcock's partner is Scully.

questions.text: Which actor plays Scully?
questions.explanation: Hitchcock and Scully became part of the main cast.

questions.text: Which actor plays the criminal Doug Judy?
questions.explanation: Craig Robinson appears as Doug Judy in at least one episode of each season.

questions.text: Which actress plays Madeline Wuntch, Holt's rival?
questions.explanation: Wuntch is Holt's former captain and later his rival.

questions.text: Which actor plays the villain called The Vulture?
questions.explanation: The Vulture's real name is Keith Pembroke.

questions.text: Which actor plays the detective Adrian Pimento?
questions.explanation: Adrian is introduced in season 3.

questions.text: Which actor plays Jake's father, Roger Peralta?
questions.explanation: Jake's family appears in several episodes.

questions.text: What is Captain Holt's first name?
questions.explanation: Raymond Holt is the captain of the 99th precinct.

questions.text: In a famous joke, what is Terry's computer password?
questions.explanation: The detectives guess it correctly: 'Terry loves yogurt'.

questions.text: How many daughters does Terry Jeffords have?
questions.explanation: Terry is a very protective dad.

questions.text: What is the name of Captain Holt's dog?
questions.explanation: Cheddar is a corgi.

questions.text: What is the first name of Captain Holt's husband?
questions.explanation: Kevin Cozner is played by Marc Evan Jackson.

questions.text: What is Doug Judy's nickname?
questions.explanation: Doug Judy often becomes friendly with Jake.

questions.text: Before the squad meets him, the detective Adrian Pimento had been undercover for how long?
questions.explanation: That is a very long time to be undercover.

questions.text: What does Jake say when he feels uneasy or awkward?
questions.explanation: Andy Samberg made this line up while filming; it was not in the script.

options.text: Cool, cool, cool, cool, cool, no doubt, no doubt, no doubt
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, hold on
Okay, okay, okay, I'm fine, I'm fine

questions.text: What word does Jake use when he is impressed?
questions.explanation: He first says it in season 1, in 'Charges and Specs'.

questions.text: Which action movie does Jake often quote?
questions.explanation: Jake loves quoting Die Hard.

questions.text: What does Captain Holt like to drink?
questions.explanation: Holt also likes plain toast and oatmeal.

questions.text: In the first Halloween Heist, what does Jake try to steal from Captain Holt?
questions.explanation: It started as a bet between Jake and Holt in season 1.

questions.text: The Halloween Heist has to be finished before what time?
questions.explanation: Whoever holds the prize at midnight wins.

questions.text: In season 6, the heist is held on which holiday?
questions.explanation: A gas explosion had delayed it.

questions.text: In 'The Jimmy Jab Games II', who hosts the games dressed as P.T. Barnum?
questions.explanation: The first Jimmy Jab Games were in season 2.

questions.text: In 'HalloVeen', Jake proposes to Amy with the words written on what?
questions.explanation: The inscription reads: 'Amy Santiago, will you marry me?'

questions.text: How does Charles react when he hears that Jake and Amy are engaged?
questions.explanation: Boyle is one of their best friends.

questions.text: Who marries Jake and Amy in the precinct parking lot?
questions.explanation: Their plans fell apart after a bomb threat, so they got married there.

questions.text: In the famous episode 'The Box', what is the suspect's job?
questions.explanation: Sterling K. Brown plays the suspect, Philip Davidson.

questions.text: In which US state do Jake and Holt hide in witness protection?
questions.explanation: Holt is thriving there.

questions.text: In season 7, what happens to Captain Holt's job?
questions.explanation: He has to get used to his new job.

options.text: He is demoted to a patrol officer

questions.text: In season 8's first episode, 'The Good Ones', what does Rosa do?
questions.explanation: Season 8 is the last season.

questions.text: In the series finale, 'The Last Day', what does Jake decide to do?
questions.explanation: Amy is about to start a new job working with Holt on police reform.

options.text: Leave the NYPD to be a full-time dad

questions.text: In 'PB & J', Doug Judy's last ride with Jake, where is he driven?
questions.explanation: It is described as the Pontiac Bandit's last ride on the show.

questions.text: In which season does Doug Judy first appear?
questions.explanation: He first shows up in the episode 'Pontiac Bandit'.

questions.text: In the episode 'Hitchcock and Scully', Jake and Charles investigate an old case from which decade?
questions.explanation: It is one of Hitchcock and Scully's cases.

questions.text: In season 7's 'Admiral Peralta', the story is about which member of Jake's family?
questions.explanation: Jake and his father deal with some unfinished family business.

questions.text: In the season 4 episode 'Cop Con', what kind of event do Jake and Amy go to?
questions.explanation: It is one of the fan favourite episodes.
